pose_constraints.posture: Steep 15-degree three-quarter stance; neck held at a mid-height 'S' curve.
pose_constraints.orientation: Subject is nearly head-on to compress the body length into a narrow vertical 'pillar' shape.
pose_constraints.grounding: Standing in ankle-deep, crystal clear water on a bed of light river gravel.
pose_constraints.framing_note: Spines must form a clear 'V' silhouette against the sky, centered within the 300px horizontal 'safe zone'.

character_details.expression: Friendly, inquisitive smirk; head tilted to show off the spine symmetry.
character_details.texture: Smooth, toy-like skin; vibrant 'skin sails' connecting the lower halves of the spines (soft-tissue theory).
features: Double row of long neck spines

environmental_details.ground: Light grey river sand and sun-bleached pebbles.
flora: Clumps of Equisetites (horsetails) emerging from the water
fauna: A small Vincelestes (mammal) watching from a nearby rock for scale
environmental_details.sky: High-contrast blue sky with a golden rim-light tracing the edges of the neck sails.
